Stop wrestling with brittle scripts and API keys—Hermes Agent gives you a self-improving AI worker with built-in memory and multi-platform messaging. 🤖🔥

Building production-grade AI assistants usually means dealing with painful fragmentation and statelessness. Hermes Agent solves this by providing a self-improving, persistent autonomous agent framework that learns from experience and runs anywhere from a $5 VPS to serverless infrastructure.

Here is what you get out of the box:
• Closed-loop autonomous learning that creates and self-improves skills from experience alongside FTS5 session search and Honcho user modeling.
• A unified multi-platform gateway supporting Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, and a rich Terminal UI with multiline editing and autocomplete.
• Multiple built-in execution backends including local, Docker, SSH, Modal, Daytona, and Vercel Sandbox for serverless hibernation and on-demand wakeups.
• Built-in cron scheduler for unattended automations like daily reports, nightly backups, and weekly audits delivered directly to any messaging platform.

Whether you are automating infrastructure monitoring inside secure Docker sandboxes or setting up an asynchronous coding assistant accessible via Telegram or Slack, Hermes scales effortlessly without vendor lock-in. 

👉 Check it out on GitHub: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent

🚀 Automate pro-grade talking-head video production directly from your AI agent using a single photo and a sentence of text.

Building multimedia automation pipelines usually means wrestling with a dozen fragmented tools for video generation, voice synthesis, and editing. 

Enter andyhuo520/digital-human-koubo: an open-source project that packages AI video generation, scriptwriting, voice normalization, and automated video editing into a reusable agent skill. Developers can now prompt their coding agent to produce complete, high-quality talking-head videos with precise lip-syncing, custom scenes, captions, and professional packaging entirely through automation.

Key features built for developers and AI engineers:
• One-Photo Personas: Maintain consistent identity, outfit, and voice across multiple generated video segments.
• Smart Quality Control: Automated cost gating calculates credit expenses, checks transcriptions via Whisper, and catches generation artifacts before batch rendering.
• Pro Audio Post-Processing: Uses 1/3-octave spectral matching, de-essing, and shared room reverb to unify separately generated voice clips into a single continuous-sounding recording.
• Remotion-Powered Editing: Features 48 creator-style packaging components and support for advanced visual effects like putting text behind the presenter.

Whether you are automating localized software release notes in multiple languages or generating personalized product recommendation clips dynamically from a database, this repository shows how to combine remote MCP servers, local CLI tools, and Remotion into a cohesive, agent-driven content factory.

👉 Check it out on GitHub: https://github.com/andyhuo520/digital-human-koubo

Turn your LLM into a ruthless, evidence-first archival researcher! 🕵️‍♂️📜

Most AI agents hallucinate family trees because they treat genealogy like creative writing. If you build vertical AI agents or love civic tech, DenisSergeevitch/ex-ussr-kinship-research is a masterclass in combining deterministic Python validation with LLM reasoning. 

This open-source AI agent skill turns LLMs into rigorous family-history researchers for the former Soviet Union and Russian Empire, complete with automated evidence auditing, provenance tracking, and historical jurisdiction modeling.

The Problem Solved:
Genealogy across the fifteen former Soviet republics is a maze of shifting borders, multi-lingual records (pre-reform Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, German, and Yiddish), and fragmented archives (church books, civil registers, military logs, and deportation files). This project equips AI agents with a structured, evidence-first framework that enforces strict logical separation between raw data sources and subjective interpretations.

Key Features Built for Scale:
• Rigorous Evidence Protocol: Assigns explainable statuses like corroborated or contradicted, backed by an audit script that checks referential integrity and prevents false proof propagation.
• Historical Jurisdiction Modeling: Resolves events to the correct state, province, and parish as of the exact event date while handling complex multi-lingual orthographies.
• Targeted Platform Integrations: Includes local Python helper scripts for FamilySearch index browsing and WWI GWAR database querying.
• Enterprise-Grade Reproducibility: Features automated case initialization, SHA-256 artifact hashing, CSV-backed search logging, and HTML-to-PDF report generation via local headless Chromium integration.

Why Developers and AI Engineers Need This:
It is an incredible architectural blueprint for building specialized archival research assistants. Study its design to master strict state management, reproducible audit trails, and hard tool-use boundaries for high-stakes information retrieval tasks where hallucinations are not an option.

👉 Check out the repo, explore the source code, and drop a star to support the project:

Ever wanted your UI components to look like an iconic Apple technical blueprint? 🍎📐

Frontend developers and design system maintainers know the pain of manually drawing architectural specs or trying to clearly communicate layout structures across teams. It is a massive time sink.

Enter dimensional-drawing: a game-changing tool that transforms any UI component, URL, or screenshot into a stunning, Apple-style technical specification sheet and animated blueprint using AI agents! 🤖✨

Here is why you need to check this out:

⚡ AI Agent Integration: Ships as portable skill packages designed for Claude Code, claude.ai, and other AI coding assistants via the skills CLI standard.
📐 Architectural Abstraction: Focuses purely on component layout using strict monochrome palettes, structural variables, and unbranded nomenclature, stripping away distractions.
🎬 Exploded Layer Motion Graphics: Turn static specs into cinematic 10-second animations showing layers lifting apart.
🎞️ Dual Rendering Adapters: Supports Claude's native Motion artifact format alongside a headless Node.js adapter with Playwright and ffmpeg for automated video generation.

Whether you are building a robust design system or want to generate cinematic technical teasers for your next product launch, this automates the entire process straight from your source code.

👉 Explore the repo and start building blueprints here: https://github.com/enesozturk/dimensional-drawing

🔥 ASLR Bypassed on Stock PHP 8.4 Prefork with a Single Command! 

Security researchers and penetration testers, we need to talk about modern exploit chains. A critical security research project has just dropped demonstrating Remote Code Execution (RCE) against completely stock Apache/PHP prefork environments running default production settings with ASLR fully enabled. No custom php.ini tricks, no display_errors manipulation, and no memory limit alterations required.

The Problem:
Proving how complex heap-layout manipulation, session management edge cases, and memory corruption primitives can be chained over standard HTTP to compromise modern web servers has traditionally been theoretical or required custom debug environments. 

The Solution:
The php2shell-bypass-aslr-exp framework provides an advanced exploit chain and proof-of-concept tool demonstrating exact, reliable RCE and ASLR defeat against default installations.

Notable Features:
🌐 Worker Pinning via HTTP Flooding: Exhausts Apache prefork worker threads using concurrent incomplete POST requests to isolate target execution to a single persistent child process.
📦 Chunked Transfer Encoding Bypass: Skips post_max_size constraints by omitting Content-Length headers, allowing large body submissions for precise heap shaping.
🧠 Dual Memory Leak and Corruption Chain: Leverages session module memory corruption vulnerabilities to perform out-of-bounds reads for ASLR defeat and arbitrary function pointer redirection for system execution.
⚙️ Multi-Architecture Support: Fully compatible with stock x86_64 and aarch64 environments running Debian and PHP 8.4.

Use this research to audit and harden your Apache and PHP runtime configurations against advanced heap manipulation attacks, or conduct controlled security regression testing in isolated sandbox environments to verify modern exploit mitigations.
